supported_scope: Checkpoint rollback of conversation history, file change diff viewing, and tracked file context management
required_setup: No special configuration required; usage of built-in commands like /rewind and /diff is default
constraints: Recovery limited to conversation checkpoints and tracked files within the session context
File diffs and rollbacks operate on files tracked in the workspace and session
No explicit mention of undoing shell effects, external actions, or deployed resources
